seo_description: Interactive geospatial tools and research dashboards by Samuel Bahago Gabriel, including PetroScreen NG and Nigerian flood, erosion, gas-flaring and environmental evidence mapping.

hero.heading: Explore the maps.
hero.intro: Try browser-based geospatial tools and research dashboards designed to make mapped evidence easier to understand. Each application explains the scope and limits of its data.

sections.heading: Screen a site
sections.intro: Preliminary browser-based screening from source-dated maps—not a field survey, risk score or regulatory clearance.

cards.title: PetroScreen NG
cards.label: Nine-state Niger Delta · research preview
cards.description: Screen 1, 3 or 5 km around a location using mapped 2021 land cover and historical water observations (1984–2024), then download a preliminary screening PDF.
cards.image_alt: Generalized nine-state ESA WorldCover 2021 pilot overview, not an individual site screening result

sections.heading: Research atlases & dashboards
sections.intro: Explore published research and planning maps with transparent source dates and methodological limits.

cards.title: Lokoja Flood Resilience
cards.label: Flood planning · Lokoja
cards.description: Explore satellite-observed flood patterns, exposure and resilience planning evidence in an interactive dashboard.

cards.title: Niger Delta Gas-Flaring Evidence Atlas
cards.label: Historical flare estimates
cards.description: Investigate satellite-estimated flaring and separate environmental follow-up shortlists; not measured pollution.
cards.image_alt: Existing editorial graphic for the gas-flaring research, not a geographical map

cards.title: Bayelsa Oil-Spill Evidence Atlas
cards.label: Documented incident history
cards.description: Explore historical spill reports and separate evaluation evidence from the Bayelsa study.
cards.image_alt: Existing editorial graphic for the Bayelsa oil-spill study, not a satellite spill observation

cards.title: Anambra Soil-Erosion Prioritization
cards.label: Erosion planning · Anambra
cards.description: Examine mapped erosion-intervention priorities and conservation scenarios in an interactive dashboard.
cards.image_alt: Existing editorial graphic for the Anambra erosion research

closing.title: Interested in how these were built?
closing.text: Project case studies explain the methods, evidence, outputs and scientific limitations behind each application.
